window.statement: From this reading onward only the review's own jobs consume the GPT (Codex) quota; no other use.
window.measure: sum of billable tokens (input + output, cached input counted separately) recorded after start_local, from 05_extraction/ai_extraction/token_ledger_v1_1.csv and any run manifest written after start_local
window.to_compute_at_exhaustion: tokens_per_percent = total_tokens_in_window / 4.0; also tokens_per_report for the extraction job
active_gpt_jobs_at_start: extraction v1.1 over the 161 included reports (gpt-6-sol, effort high, concurrency 6)
non_gpt_jobs_at_start: second open-access fetch pass (network only, no model)
